policies.sourceText: All courses offered for the minor must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher.
All courses offered for the minor must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher. No transfer credits with a grade lower than C may be applied to the minor requirements.

notes.text: No transfer credits with a grade lower than C may be applied to the minor requirements.
Students majoring in Human Evolutionary Biology (EBH) may have a maximum of nine (9) credits of overlap between EBH major coursework and ANT minor coursework.
